Hi Karthik,

Thanks for taking this — we're trying to finish vendor enrollment for Redwood so AP can start routing POs and invoices into our eInvoicing pipeline. Attached are two files: Sunbeam_PO-Schema_v2.1.xsd and our Vendor-Enrollment-Form.pdf. A couple of specific questions up front so we can scope the integration:

- PO encoding: our eInvoice platform expects the PO number in the UBL invoice header as <cbc:ID> with a namespace attribute (we use urn:sb:po). We also accept a line-item <cac:OrderLine><cbc:OrderReference><cbc:ID> for line-level matching. Can Redwood emit the PO in the invoice XML header and optionally at line level?
- SSO for vendor portal: Do you support SAML 2.0 SP-initiated SSO? We need to provision vendors into our portal (Sunbeam Vendor Hub) and prefer SAML over username/password.
- EFT / remittance: we require IBAN/BIC for EU suppliers and a remittance reference that maps to the PO (we prefer remittance files in ISO 20022 pain.001 format). Can you provide a template?
- VAT / tax evidence: we'll need vendor VAT registration (EU VAT) and a certificate for reverse-charge scenarios. Will Redwood provide the VAT ID and legal entity name on the onboarding form?

Target: we'd like the vendor activation completed and a short test exchange (sample invoice) by next Friday, 22 Jun.

Appreciate a quick reply with where to upload the enrollment form and any sample artifacts you can share (sample invoice XML, bank routing details).

Best,
Anya

Hi Anya — thanks for the detail and the XSD. Looping in Laura (AP) and Marissa (Solutions) so we can coordinate the onboarding and the sample artifacts. Quick answers / clarifying questions below:

- PO placement: We can emit the PO in the invoice header (<cbc:ID>) and include line-level <OrderReference> if the buyer requires line matching. Is header-only acceptable for initial go-live, with line-level added later if needed?
- Namespace: your XSD uses urn:sb:po for the PO element; we'll validate against that. Any strict expectations about element attributes or prefixing?
- SSO: we support SAML 2.0 and OIDC; we typically act as the SP and can accept either. Which binding does Sunbeam prefer (HTTP-POST vs Redirect)?
- EFT format: we can generate ISO 20022 pain.001 payloads and remittance advice; can you confirm SCT (SEPA Credit Transfer) vs other local rails?
- VAT: we'll provide the company VAT ID and legal name on the enrollment form. For US legal entities we usually provide W-9; for EU entities we'll provide VAT certs.

I'll follow up with a sample UBL invoice and an internal checklist for the onboarding steps. If header-only PO works, we can spin up a test invoice by EOD Monday and aim for a live exchange the week of Jun 25.

Thanks,

Hi Anya — Laura from Redwood AP here. Thanks for sending the schema. A few AP-specific requirements and notes for your team: 

1) PO matching and tolerances
- We can accept header-level PO (<cbc:ID>) for matching. If you require line-level reconciliation we'll add <cac:OrderLine><cbc:OrderReference><cbc:ID> as you've described. Please note our matching tolerance: subtotal variation +/- 0.5% allowed for tax rounding differences.

2) Invoicing namespace and elements
- Your XSD's PO namespace (urn:sb:po) is fine. We ask that PO IDs be plain ASCII (no embedded emojis/Unicode) and prefixed consistently (e.g. SB-12345). Avoid including human-readable labels in the ID field.

3) Remittance & bank details
- For EU accounts we need IBAN + BIC in the bank data block. Remittance reference must include the PO ID and our short vendor code. Preferred remittance file: ISO 20022 pain.001 with separate remittance advice (pain.002 optional).

4) VAT / tax evidence
- Please capture supplier VAT ID (VIES checkable) and a PDF of the VAT registration or certificate when uploading the Vendor-Enrollment-Form. For reverse-charge scenarios, we'll set tax fields to 0% and include a note referencing the tax regulation — we will need your legal entity name exactly as registered.

5) Data retention / audit
- Invoices and attachments must be retained for 7 years for audit. We will request a signed copy of the Vendor-Enrollment-Form (DocuSign fine).

6) Test and cutover
- We prefer a staged cutover: staging test (sample invoice exchange), small-volume pilot (5–10 invoices), then full cutover. If you can provide a UBL sample with the PO in header by Monday we can run automated validation.

I've attached a small bundle with examples we typically ask vendors to provide (redwood_vendor_evidence.zip). It contains: bank stub template, VAT cert checklist, and a sample pain.001 remittance.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
